gloss: potluck party; a party where each guest brings a dish or drink to share

definitions.gloss: potluck party; a party where each guest brings a dish or drink to share
definitions.explanation: Common in both casual and semi-formal social gatherings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have a potluck party this weekend.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティーな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Since it's a potluck party, please bring one dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the potluck party with a homemade dish.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{持ち寄|もちよ}り→持ち寄り：08471_mochiyori⟧ (bringing together/each contributing) and ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧ (party). Refers to a social gathering where participants each bring food or drinks to share, rather than a single host providing everything.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a potluck party
- {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦{持参|じさん}→持参：00127_jisan⟧: bring one dish to the potluck
- {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧: potluck-style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポット→ポット：05286_potto⟧⟦ラック→ラック：27072_rakku⟧: potluck (loanword, less common)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧: drinking party (usually at a restaurant)
- ⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: home party (host provides food)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Potluck parties have become increasingly popular in Japan, especially among younger people and international communities. They offer a more affordable and interactive alternative to traditional ⟦{飲み会|のみかい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ at restaurants. In Japanese potlucks, guests typically bring either homemade dishes or store-bought items like ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (prepared dishes) or desserts.
